newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling steady on dollar, firm on pound.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling steady on dollar, firm on pound.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling held steady against the dollar but firmed versus the pound on Monday as forex inflows continued to outstrip demand, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a mean shilling average of 55.69 against the dollar from 55.68 on Friday. Against the pound, it was posted at 92.75 from 92.83.
"(Foreign exchange) inflows from the agricultural sector continued to lend support to the shilling," a commercial dealer said.
One dealer said the market was dull with very few players.
"The oil boys have generally adopted a wait-and-see attitude perhaps waiting to see the dollar at lower levels," one said.
Oil companies were responsible for increased importer foreign exchange demand about two weeks ago and caused the shilling to weaken against the dollar temporarily, dealers said.
But since, dealers said the shilling has broken the 55.70 resistance level to trade at 55.62/68. They expected it to firm against the dollar as exporter dollar sales continued unabated.

The overnight money market was a bit tight with rates quoted between 20 and 25 percent from above 25 percent on Friday. Rates were forecast to ease with treasury bill maturities coming into the market this week.
